top_comments.author: @hjekel
top_comments.text: Installing an extension that requires permission to monitor your IDE, terminal, and local file system for the sake of 'ad revenue' is a massive security red flag. No developer should be granting third-party ad-platforms access to their source code environment. Stay safe—this is a disaster waiting to happen.
